description: Parametric CAD generation using CadQuery Python library - Generate 3D models, validate code, export to STEP/STL/DXF formats

tools.name: generate_cad_from_code
tools.description: Generate 3D CAD geometry from CadQuery Python code. AI writes the code, CadQuery generates professional-quality CAD geometry. Exports to STEP and STL formats. Use when users request 3D models, CAD designs, or technical drawings.

code.description: CadQuery Python code that creates geometry. MUST set 'result' variable. Example: result = cq.Workplane('XY').box(100, 100, 50)

description.description: Human-readable description of the CAD part (e.g., 'Fiat Ducato 2011 van body')

tools.name: validate_cadquery_code
tools.description: Validate CadQuery Python code before execution. Checks for syntax errors, missing imports, and common mistakes. Use this before calling generate_cad_from_code to avoid errors.

tools.name: list_cadquery_templates
tools.description: List all available CadQuery code templates (examples). Includes fasteners (hex bolts, screws), gears, bearings, mechanical parts, automotive components, and enclosures. Use these as reference patterns for creating new designs.

tools.name: get_cadquery_template
tools.description: Get specific CadQuery template code by name. Returns working Python code that can be modified. Available templates: hex_bolt, socket_head_cap_screw, spur_gear, ball_bearing, t_slot_extrusion, simple_car_body, wheel_rim, enclosure_box.

tools.name: cadquery_export_dxf
tools.description: Export STEP file to DXF format for laser cutting or CNC machining. Converts 3D CAD to 2D profile suitable for manufacturing.

step_file_path.description: Path to STEP file (from generate_cad_from_code result)

output_path.description: Optional custom output path for DXF file

tools.name: cadquery_export_svg
tools.description: Export STEP file to SVG format for technical drawings and documentation. Creates 2D vector graphics with orthographic projections.

step_file_path.description: Path to STEP file (from generate_cad_from_code result)

output_path.description: Optional custom output path for SVG file

tools.name: cadquery_list_generated_files
tools.description: List all previously generated CAD files (STEP, STL, DXF, SVG). Shows file names, sizes, creation dates. Use to find and reference existing CAD models.

tools.name: cadquery_get_file_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific CAD file. Returns geometry statistics (vertices, faces, volume), bounding box, and file metadata.

file_path.description: Path to CAD file (STEP or STL)

tools.name: cadquery_calculate_mass
tools.description: Calculate mass properties of a CAD part given material density. Returns mass, center of gravity, and moment of inertia. Use for engineering analysis and weight calculations.

density_g_cm3.description: Material density in g/cm³ (e.g., 2.7 for aluminum, 7.85 for steel, 1.2 for ABS plastic)
